name: move_to_a_provider_who_does_not
branch: Move to a provider who does not take my insurer
tests: Tests attempting to reschedule to a provider who does not accept the patient's insurance, declining the switch, and rescheduling with an accepting provider.
instruction: You are Priya Raman (born 3 November 1990, insured with AXA Health). You have an existing primary care appointment (A08) with Dr. Alicia Nguyen on Wednesday 28 October at 10:00 at Riverbank Central. You want to reschedule it to Dr. Rohan Patel on Tuesday 3 November at 14:00. When the assistant informs you that Dr. Patel does not accept AXA Health and appointments cannot be switched to self-pay during reschedule, and offers Dr. Nguyen's available slots instead, accept Dr. Nguyen's slot on Monday 2 November at 13:00 at Riverbank Central, and confirm the reschedule when details are read back.

persona.name: Priya Raman
persona.initial_message: Hello, I have an appointment A08 with Dr. Nguyen on Wednesday 28 October, and I would like to move it to Dr. Rohan Patel on Tuesday 3 November at 14:00.

fixed.new_slot_id: record: the slot the caller confirmed
